chapterBreakdown.direct: Stillness matters here because discipline now includes repair, not just force.

chapterBreakdown.gentle: Addison's disease changes the chapter because aggression cannot solve it. The lesson becomes structural: repair, stretching, and patience are disciplined responses to a real limit.
chapterBreakdown.direct: This chapter deepens when recovery stops looking soft and starts looking like a hard adjustment to bodily facts.
chapterBreakdown.competitive: This is not surrender. It is learning that discipline includes the work that keeps you from breaking yourself in the name of edge.

chapterBreakdown.gentle: The deeper boundary is that reflection can still go soft if it detaches from cost. This chapter stays honest by tying hope to disease, repair work, and relationships that had to be rebuilt slowly.
chapterBreakdown.direct: Hard depth adds a limit: you cannot turn recovery into another victory speech without losing the point. The discipline here is accepting a body-imposed boundary and building a future that still has edge.
chapterBreakdown.competitive: The hidden structure is that maturity costs pride. If every setback has to become another domination story, you miss the harder move: staying exact, repairing what broke, and letting the ending remain open.
